about_the_game:
History is written by the victors… but some lessons refuse to be forgotten.

A new horror lurks within Dardki High School, buried deep in the faculty wing. Students whisper about an old history teacher, a scholar who vanished under mysterious circumstances—only to return as an unstoppable force of knowledge and vengeance. Now, she roams the halls, rewriting history with fire, steel, and parchment.

Face the Ultimate Exam

In this challenging new boss fight, players will battle the Mad Historian, a spectral embodiment of history itself. She wields devastating attacks inspired by great empires, revolutions, and disasters, unleashing the wrath of time upon those who dare oppose her.

New Features:

🖊️ New Boss Battle: Test your reflexes and knowledge against The Mad Historian, whose attacks summon the horrors of history, from Napoleonic charges to the wrath of the Pharaohs.
📜 New Area – The Forgotten Lecture Hall: A decaying classroom lost in time, where history’s greatest conflicts are brought to life.
🔥 New Ability – The Rebel’s Resolve: Unlock a unique counter-attack that lets you defy history and turn the tide of battle.

Signature Attack: "Declaration of Annihilation"

When cornered, The Mad Historian summons a burning Declaration of Independence, launching fiery words like "Liberty" and "Justice" at you—each one exploding on impact. Can you dodge the flames of revolution?

Will you rewrite history, or become another forgotten page?

The Wrath of the History Rewritten DLC is coming soon to Metits Magic 3: The Revenge of Luli. Prepare for the hardest lesson you’ve ever faced.

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i5 14600KF or RYZEN 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2050 or GTX 1660
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: History is alive… and it wants revenge. In History Rewritten, face The Mad Historian, a spectral teacher who bends time to rewrite the past. Battle through The Forgotten Lecture Hall, dodge flaming words of the Declaration of Independence, and survive history’s deadliest lessons!
